SELECT t.transaction_id, t.type, t.amount, t.memo, t.occurred_at, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.emotion_id, e.name AS emotion_name, e.color AS emotion_color FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id
ORDER BY t.occurred_at ASC, t.transaction_id ASC ORDER BY c.name ASC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY c.name DESC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY t.amount ASC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY t.amount DESC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY t.occurred_at DESC, t.transaction_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, emotion_id, category_id, type, amount, memo, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{emotionId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{memo}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_id, t.type, t.amount, t.memo, t.occurred_at, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.emotion_id, e.name AS emotion_name, e.color AS emotion_color FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id WHERE t.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}

mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET emotion_id = #{emotionId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, memo = #{memo}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt} WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
